title: "Editorial work"
---

## Creating an editorial case

Choose a private, local workspace location using the [workstation-setup Nextcloud guidance](https://fs-ise.github.io/workstation-setup/nextcloud.html). The location can differ across machines.

```sh
labot editorial create
```

LaBot prompts for the editorial role, submission ID, optional round, manuscript PDF, reviewer-files folder, and optional deadline. Choose an existing role or create a new one. It creates `<role>/<submission-id>[.<round>]/` with `README.md`, `report.qmd`, and `reviews/`; provided source files are copied into the case.

For non-interactive setup, provide the case details directly:

```sh
labot editorial create \
  --role AE_venue2026 \
  --submission-id submission-id \
  --round R1 \
  --manuscript "/path/to/manuscript.pdf" \
  --reviews-dir "/path/to/reviewer-files" \
  --deadline '2026-12-15 09:00' \
  --reminder-days 7
```

For non-interactive use, the `--role` directory must already exist. If a deadline is supplied, LaBot creates `task.ics`; import it into Thunderbird Tasks to schedule the reminder. Work directly in the case folder, use relative links to its files, and record a related peer-review case by its restricted local path rather than copying its files. Do not commit manuscripts, reviews, or editorial assessments to a public or shared repository.


## Pre-publishing checks (paper polishing)

```sh
colrev convert references.md
# select *bib*
git init
git add .
colrev-sync sync
```
